1.1: This Jude talkin'—I'm a servant of Jesus Christ and James' brother. I'm writin' to all y'all who been called, made holy by God the Father, and kept covered in Jesus.
1.2: May mercy, peace, and love multiply all over your life. 🕊️
1.3: Look, fam—I wanted to write you about the good news we all share. But I had to switch it up and urge y'all to fight for the faith. The same faith that was once and for all handed down to God's people.
1.4: 'Cause some folks snuck in sideways—folks who been marked for judgment a long time ago. Ungodly people who twist grace into wild livin', and straight up deny Jesus, our one true Lord.
1.5: Let me remind you, even though you already know this: The Lord saved His people outta Egypt… but then turned around and destroyed the ones who ain't believe.
1.6: And the angels who stepped outta line, left their God-given post? He got them locked in darkness, chained up 'til Judgment Day.
1.7: Same with Sodom and Gomorrah—they gave themselves over to wild sexual sin and strange flesh. They're sittin' as the example now—payin' for it in eternal fire. 🔥
1.8: Just like them, these fake dreamers out here defilin' their bodies, disrespectin' authority, and talkin' crazy about things they don't even understand.
1.9: Even Michael the archangel ain't get reckless like that. When he argued with the devil about Moses' body, he ain't come with slander. He just said, "The Lord rebuke you." That's power with restraint.
1.10: But these folks? They run they mouths 'bout what they don't know, act off instincts like animals—and end up destroyin' themselves.
1.11: Woe to them! They walkin' like Cain (jealous and murderous), chasin' money like Balaam, and fallin' into rebellion like Korah. It's gon' end bad.
1.12: They like stains on your church dinners—eatin' with no shame, only out for themselves. They clouds with no rain, trees with no fruit—dead and uprooted. Late fall vibes. No harvest. 🍂
1.13: They wild like ocean waves, bringin' shame up like sea foam. They stars that lost they course—destined for eternal darkness. 💨
1.14: Enoch—seventh from Adam—already prophesied about them: "The Lord's comin' with thousands of His holy ones,
1.15: To bring judgment to the ungodly for all the messy, rebellious, disrespectful stuff they've done and said."
1.16: These folks stay grumblin' and complainin', walkin' by lust, not the Spirit. They mouth off with fancy words, flatterin' people to get ahead. Fake with a purpose.
1.17: But you, beloved—remember what the apostles of Jesus said:
1.18: "In the last days, mockers gon' come. Folk led by they own ungodly cravings."
1.19: They sensual. They divisive. And they ain't got the Spirit. Period.
1.20: But you? Build yourself up in the most holy faith. Pray in the Spirit.
1.21: Keep yourself in God's love. Wait for the mercy of Jesus—it's gon' bring you eternal life. 🕯️
1.23: Others? Snatch 'em out the fire. Save them, but stay clear of the sin attached to 'em—hate the dirt, not the soul. 🧤🔥
1.24: Now unto the One who can keep you from fallin', And present you clean, in joy, before His glorious presence—
1.25: To the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord: Glory, honor, power, and rule—now and forever. Amen. 👑
